in_sanskrit.name: Dravinya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fearless, Brave One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dravinya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dravinya is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'dravin', meaning 'vehicle' or 'carrier'. In Hindu mythology, Dravinya is known as the fearless and brave goddess who rides on Lord Vishnu's vehicle, the Garuda. She is a symbol of courage, strength, and protection.
